scope: Fixed actual Node syntax/test commands on broker-captured authorized read-only input snapshots, durable original calls/receipts, shared parent tool facts and original native resource recovery

preliminary.initial_final_not_final_code: The first broad run preceded the final policy-anchor and stored-source replay integrity refinements. It is retained as preliminary evidence, not final source validation.
preliminary.initial_failures: Initial verbose run: JSON parsing retained null prototypes, causing otherwise equal replay input to conflict; normalized only after strict duplicate-key parsing. Node spawnSync hung in the single-process Windows Job even with its own 500ms timeout; native timeout remained authoritative. One focused assertion used the wrong CommandReceipt failure shape; corrected to original code: RECOVERY_CONDITIONS_UNMET.

schemas.comparison: exact text normalized CRLF to LF

implemented.catalog: Trusted composition installs exact Node syntax or single-process node:test recipes with pinned source paths/digests and finite elapsed/output limits. Tool frame accepts check_id/call_id only; no executable, argv, shell, cwd, source body, environment or caller selection. Scope and recipes detach before async compilation. Current API is trusted composition only; no original SDK check consumer yet.
implemented.authority: Actual Kernel assesses every original source read and the run_checks entry against the immutable original Agent Scope. Rechecks before reads, after each original capture, after snapshot and after durable dispatch before native start. Original basis changes/revocation deny; independent read-only Context remains restricted.
implemented.capture: Actual native file broker pins original root/file handle identity and digest, reads exact UTF-8 bytes and copies bounded sources. Separate native controller launches only the fixed argv in a read-only private workspace with no network capabilities, atomic single-process Job and 2GiB Job memory. Original native startup/policy/ownership/cleanup records stay outside runtime sandbox.
implemented.records: Original project policy pins root identity/node digest/128 lifetime logical slots. Exclusive slot allocation precedes original operation directory; contender releases only its just-created verified empty slot. Input Scope/call/recipe/policy/current basis digest persists before capture; dispatch persists before native start. Original receipt pins source and raw stdout/stderr digests, actual exit/cleanup and exact capture counts. Fresh current authority, original request, snapshots and original raw records validate replay. No original key retries an unproven command.
implemented.parent: Local Agent service can install/run trusted checks. Parent readWorkspaceToolRunFacts adds file and check invocation/unresolved/effect counts; check Unknown prevents both Agent observation and Human reconciliation settling parent Run/budget. A checker receipt never completes a Task/Run or approves a Gate.
implemented.recovery: Trusted original owner PID/creation/image and original native ownership govern resource recovery. Actual owned controller fault injection holds and verifies its OS handle before kill. New host proves original owners ended and invokes source/binary-pinned controller recovery to remove original mapping/ACL/profile; absent original completion remains Unknown and repeat calls never execute again.

validation.prior_opencode_startup_failure: final-2: 131/132 passed; original OpenCode WorkItem revocation case hit workspace_rehearsal_deadline before suspended proof. Retained operation has original-config.json, no startup/cleanup proof, and residual original sandbox SID ACL, original Y: DOS mapping and original Profile registry mapping (read-only nonce-derived SID and exact root query). No matching active owned executable observed; resource disposal is not proven. Raw stdout/stderr were lost in the prior failure path. This batch preserves bounded original raw output and an explicitly incomplete diagnostic on future startup/channel failures; controlled channel failure asserts it. The old root is retained; broad recovery remains pending. A later successful regression does not prove the root failure repaired.
validation.actual_windows_node: 10 actual Windows scenarios cover original syntax success/failure, native node:test success and snapshot write denial, two original hosts competing/replaying, trusted local service composition, changed recipe conflict, corrupted raw/source replay denial, current WorkItem revocation, dispatch loss, native-bounded spawnSync hang, truncated output and parent block, logical slot refusal, and actual original controller/host death resource recovery.
validation.qualifier: Kernel/Git/SQLite/file/Node/OS effects are actual. Positive Native Agent admission and provider bindings remain constructed fixture inputs. No actual model, Skill behavior, account custody, fee enforcement or full S1 admission is proved.
validation.node_spawn_sync: Actual spawnSync did not return in the single-process Windows Job, including a requested internal 500ms timeout. Reached-before/no-after stdout and original native timeout/exit124/cleaned resources are asserted. Normal single-process node:test works. This is not labelled proven synchronous child-start error handling, and Job process limit is not relaxed.
validation.slots: The full-slot test uses 128 constructed occupied directories, not 128 actual check launches or a physical filesystem hard quota.

boundaries.commands: First two Node profiles only; no arbitrary shell, npm/pnpm install or script engine, no inherited model-selected env/args. Binary provenance still needs formal protected admission. Check pass means the installed command actually exited zero; it is not independent semantic review or Gate approval.
boundaries.custody: Check ID directory is trusted composition input but not yet fixed in production admission/Context. Original SDK call ID derivation and authenticated cimi_check transport remain pending; current call_id is supplied by trusted composition. No default production verifier enabled.
boundaries.limits: Native command elapsed/output/memory and logical 128 project-call bounds are implemented. Global preparation/combined nested Run deadlines, complete retention/capacity rotation, physical hard quota and all original runtime resource recovery remain pending.
boundaries.external: User confirmed Zhipu provider. Exact approved model/plan and cash/credit ceiling remain missing; this batch reads no credential and sends no external model request.
